key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:6776
name: close_input_device
description: Sets up a close request on the input device, sends it, then closes the device and releases the port and request.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:67BC
name: place_sprite_slots_from_table
description: Walks a per-level table of sprite entries and records the flagged ones, then fills the remaining slots of twelve with two alternating image codes. It positions each filled slot and marks unused slots with a flag value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:68DA
name: draw_sprite_slot_images
description: Chooses an image index for a sprite slot from the current level, then draws it at the slot position, with a second image for the frame pair and a third placed from a per-level offset.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:6A76
name: dispatch_level_mode_actions
description: Switches on the current level and then on a mode code. In mode five it draws thirty-one rows of table-driven image blocks, and in mode six it works through a per-item table, playing sounds, showing messages and adjusting stored counts for the item it finds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:7EC8
name: place_actor_or_retry
description: Tries up to twenty-five times to find a valid position for the stored coordinates, and when one is found it calls a routine to place the actor there and then calls a handler with code five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:7F0E
name: place_actor_and_notify
description: Places the actor at the stored coordinates through a routine taking a flag of one, then calls the same handler with code five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:7F36
name: set_level_and_reset_counter
description: Stores the given value as the current level and clears a counter, then calls a routine to load that level, but only when a lock flag is clear.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:7F56
name: load_config_bytes_from_lookup
description: Fills several small tables by calling a lookup routine for consecutive indices, storing seven pairs of values and six further values. It sets one count from whether any of the six values is ten, and stores two more entries from fixed indices.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8008
name: wait_until_counter_reaches_ten
description: Repeatedly calls a routine until the stored counter reaches ten, then returns. It does no other work while it waits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:801C
name: refresh_changed_slot_images
description: For the current slot, compares each stored field with its last value and, wherever a value has changed, loads the matching image block and records the new value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:829A
name: draw_buffer_when_enabled
description: When the enable flag is set, calls a drawing routine with the buffer address and half the stored length for the given slot, passing the extra parameter through. It does nothing when the flag is clear.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:82DA
name: clear_buffers_set_table
description: Clears three 35-byte buffers, points the working table at the entry for the current level, and clears a 60-byte block.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:832E
name: store_value_in_node
description: Stores the value passed on the stack into the second longword of the node that the address register points to.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8334
name: process_event_record_list
description: Walks a list of event records, and for each one either stores a looked-up code in a circular buffer or copies a changed value into it when a position flag changes. It advances the buffer's write index with a wrap at 127.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:838A
name: queue_mapped_event_code
description: Converts a changed coordinate pair into an event code, using a range check and a division by nine, and stores that code in a circular buffer. It then records the new position in the list entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:83B6
name: clamp_position_and_walk_list
description: Clamps a moving object's coordinates into the playfield range, stores them, and calls a handler when the object has one. It then steps to the next linked entry and repeats until the list ends.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:84E4
name: read_ring_buffer_byte
description: Returns the next byte from a 128-byte circular buffer when the read and write indices differ, advancing the read index with a wrap at 127. It returns zero when the buffer is empty.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:850E
name: next_pseudo_random_value
description: Advances a 16-bit seed by multiplying it and adding one, then returns a value built from shifted bits of the new seed. Several other routines in this program call it for random values.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8526
name: mask_random_value
description: Takes a fresh random value and returns it ANDed with the parameter, so only the bits set in the mask survive.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:852E
name: pick_random_bit
description: Returns the lowest bit of a fresh random value, so the result is zero or one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8538
name: pick_random_two_bits
description: Returns the low two bits of a fresh random value, so the result runs from zero to three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8542
name: pick_random_three_bits
description: Returns the low three bits of a fresh random value, so the result runs from zero to seven.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:854C
name: pick_random_six_bits
description: Returns the low six bits of a fresh random value, so the result runs from zero to sixty-three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8556
name: return_random_byte
description: Returns the low byte of a fresh random value and nothing else.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8560
name: pick_random_below_limit
description: Takes a fresh random value modulo the limit passed in, and returns the remainder together with the limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8574
name: invoke_library_vector_60
description: Calls a routine, then a library function at a fixed offset from a stored library base, and returns the two result registers unchanged. It is a wrapper around that library call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:85A0
name: format_number_as_decimal_text
description: Writes an unsigned number into a ten-character buffer as decimal digits, filling from the right. Any leading positions left unused are filled with spaces.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:85A8
name: format_number_into_field
description: Writes an unsigned number as decimal digits into a field, working from a given end position toward the start. Once the number runs out, the remaining positions are filled with spaces.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:85C4
name: fill_field_with_spaces
description: Writes space characters into a field from a given end position back to its start. It does nothing else.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:85F0
name: run_nested_callback_loop
description: Runs three nested countdown loops, calling a library routine on every innermost pass, and makes extra calls to two more routines when the outer counter is above nine. It returns the input registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:86F4
name: draw_text_string_segments
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, counting each run of ordinary characters and passing it to a text-output routine. A special marker byte instead calls a separate routine, and the walk stops at the terminator.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8748
name: lookup_tile_flag_nibble
description: Derives a tile index from two coordinates and a lookup table, then tests a bit chosen from the coordinate flags. It returns the high nibble of a second table entry when that bit is set, and zero otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8750
name: lookup_tile_flag_nibble
description: Derives a tile index from two coordinates and a lookup table, then tests a bit chosen from the coordinate flags. It returns the high nibble of a second table entry when that bit is set, and zero otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:87E8
name: call_library_then_decrement_counter
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset, then decrements a stored counter by four. It is used to step the counter back after the call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:880A
name: call_library_reduce_counter
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset, then subtracts a stored value plus four from a stored counter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8832
name: call_routine_eighteen_times
description: Calls one routine with a stored parameter, then calls another routine eighteen times in a row, and returns the input registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:88EA
name: call_routine_six_times
description: Calls one routine six times in a row and returns the input registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8904
name: copy_words_into_five_planes
description: Copies pairs of 16-bit words from a source block into five destination buffers, writing each pair as two rows forty bytes apart and advancing eighty bytes per row. The loop runs sixteen times.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:895E
name: return_immediately_stub
description: Contains only a return, with no calls, memory access or register work. It is an empty entry in the fmain code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8968
name: call_routine_with_stored_parameter
description: Calls one routine with a stored parameter and returns the input registers unchanged. It is a one-line forwarding wrapper.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:89C2
name: call_routine_eighteen_times
description: Calls one routine with a stored parameter, then calls another routine eighteen times in a row, and returns the input registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8A5C
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns straight away, with no other work. It is a forwarding entry in the game code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8A6A
name: process_clamped_tile_grid
description: Clamps two coordinates into the map window, then walks a grid of nine rows by eighteen columns. For each cell it looks up a tile code and passes it to a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8B2A
name: pack_bitplane_bits_into_words
description: Reads a table of bit-selection bytes, shifting one bit from each lookup into a set of registers. It builds one word for each of five output planes and stores the words in five buffers, sixteen columns at a time.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8BC2
name: copy_tile_block_rows
description: Copies an eight-row block of four-word tile data into a destination area, with the row offsets set by the parameters.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8C12
name: compute_tile_map_address
description: Clamps the row and column derived from two coordinates into the map bounds, then combines them with a tile nibble and a table lookup to return the address of the map entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8C7E
name: fill_tile_window_from_map
description: Walks a grid of positions around the given coordinates, clamps each to the map bounds, and stores the looked-up tile code for each position in a working buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8D42
name: unpack_run_length_block
description: When a mode flag is set, expands a run-length packed buffer into an output area. A negative count repeats the following byte, and a positive count copies that many literal bytes plus one, and the read position is saved for the next call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8DBE
name: scale_value_by_table
description: When the index is below eight, scales a short value by a table entry chosen by that index, halves it, adds it to the first value and keeps the result to fifteen bits. Otherwise it returns the first value unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8DE8
name: scale_value_with_sign
description: When the index is below eight, adds a table-scaled amount to the low fifteen bits of the first value and keeps the sign bit of that value. Otherwise it returns the first value unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8E1A
name: copy_bit14_into_bit15
description: Sets the top bit of the value when bit fourteen is set, and clears the top bit otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8E2A
name: clear_top_bit
description: Returns the value with its top bit cleared, keeping the low fifteen bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8E30
name: step_scroll_offsets_toward_target
description: Moves two stored offsets toward target values: each snaps to its target when it is far away, and otherwise steps by one when the difference exceeds a set margin.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8E68
name: step_scroll_offsets_from_registers
description: Steps two stored offsets from register inputs. The horizontal offset is nudged by one or snapped to a target, and the vertical offset snaps to a computed edge when far away or is nudged otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8E78
name: nudge_scroll_offsets_from_registers
description: Nudges the horizontal offset by one when it lies beyond twenty, and nudges or snaps the vertical offset depending on how far it is from its target.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8E84
name: nudge_scroll_offsets_forward
description: Moves the horizontal offset forward by one when the input is beyond twenty, and nudges or snaps the vertical offset depending on its distance from the target.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8E9E
name: nudge_vertical_scroll_offset
description: Nudges the vertical offset by one toward the input or snaps it to a computed edge when it is far away. The horizontal offset is left alone.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8EAE
name: nudge_vertical_offset_from_input
description: Moves the vertical offset down by one when the input is below minus ten, or up by one when it is above ten, and leaves it alone inside that band.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8EBA
name: nudge_vertical_offset_forward
description: Increases the vertical offset by one when the input is above ten, and otherwise leaves it unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8ED0
name: handle_error_message
description: When the status code is not two, calls a routine with fixed arguments, then one with a global pointer and six, and finishes by calling again with the status code and two. The referenced text includes 'ERROR', which this path reports.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8F08
name: map_value_to_small_index
description: Returns a small index from three to ten by checking the input against a sequence of thresholds, starting from a table byte for the value. The second register is returned unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8F54
name: read_joystick_direction_code
description: When a flag is clear, reads two joystick direction bits, combines them into a code from a lookup table and sets a debounce counter. When the flag is set, it picks a code from thresholds on a stored position instead.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8F68
name: read_joystick_direction_code
description: When a flag is clear, reads two joystick direction bits, combines them into a code from a lookup table and sets a debounce counter. When the flag is set, it picks a code from thresholds on a stored position instead.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:8FBA
name: update_joystick_direction_state
description: Reads the joystick port direction bits and maps them to a code from a table, with a counter that resets when the stick is centred. When the code changes, it stores the new code and calls a handler with it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:900C
name: clamp_counter_and_notify
description: Subtracts twenty from a stored counter and clamps the result into the range zero to nine, resetting the counter when it goes out of range. When the clamped value changes it stores it and calls a handler with it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9020
name: reset_counter_to_nine
description: Clears a counter, and when the stored value is not nine it stores nine there and calls a handler with nine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:903E
name: resolve_two_step_code
description: Calls a routine and, if its short result is neither one nor at least ten, calls a second routine and zeroes the result when that is neither one nor below eight. It returns the final value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:907A
name: combine_five_planes_inverted
description: ANDs five source words together for each position in a block, inverts the result and writes it to the destination. The block is walked row by row over the set row count.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:910C
name: setup_blitter_for_five_blits
description: Waits for the blitter to be free, then programs the blitter registers for five blit slots. The source and destination addresses come from stored tables, and the modulo and mask values are set alongside them.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:919C
name: set_blitter_regs
description: Writes fixed control values to the blitter's control and modulo registers, sets the destination address from the first parameter and the blit size from the second, and returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:91C6
name: queue_masked_blit_rows
description: For five rows, programs the blitter with first and last word masks computed from a shift value, and sets the source, destination and modulo addresses from stored tables.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9280
name: program_single_blit
description: Programs the blitter for one rectangle. It fixes the control values, sets the source, destination and mask addresses from stored position data, and sets the blit size.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:930A
name: program_five_blit_rows
description: Programs five blit rows from a position table, setting the control values, the destination and source addresses, and the modulo values for each row.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:938A
name: program_five_blit_rows_alt
description: Programs five blit rows from a position table with the row and column offsets swapped, setting the control values, addresses and modulo values for each row.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:940E
name: dispatch_via_jump_vector
description: Calls a routine through an indirect pointer stored in memory, which the decompiler could not resolve into a jump table. It does nothing else.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:94EC
name: dispatch_via_stored_vector
description: Calls a routine through another indirect pointer stored in memory, which the decompiler could not resolve into a jump table. It does nothing else.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9BE6
name: compare_offsets_with_mode_thresholds
description: Takes the differences between a stored position and two coordinates, records the sign of each difference, and compares their combined magnitude against a threshold chosen by the mode code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9BF0
name: compare_offsets_with_mode_thresholds
description: Takes the differences between a stored position and two coordinates, records the sign of each difference, and compares their combined magnitude against a threshold chosen by the mode code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9C2C
name: lookup_direction_code_from_signs
description: Works out a direction code from the signs of two movement components, using a lookup table indexed by the combined signs. Code nine is stored as a special value, and other codes are passed on to a further check.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9C3A
name: select_direction_from_signs
description: Works out a direction code from the signs of two movement components, using a lookup table, and sets a state code. Some results call further routines that choose a target offset.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9CA4
name: set_facing_from_components
description: Computes a facing value from two components, negating one when a status bit is clear, and masks the sum to three bits. It sets a state code of twelve unless the mode is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9CB2
name: store_masked_byte_difference
description: Stores the difference of two components, masked to three bits, into one byte of a record, and sets a state code of twelve unless the mode is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9CCE
name: update_actor_movement_step
description: Adjusts a stored value by a step amount, then either sets a stop code or passes the position on to a further routine, depending on a state code and flag. A value that goes negative is reset to zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9D34
name: advance_actor_toward_target
description: Subtracts a step length from a stored value and clamps negative results to zero. It then picks a random target offset from the direction codes and passes a coordinate on to another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9D6A
name: choose_target_offset_by_direction
description: Subtracts a step from a stored value, clamps negative results to zero, and picks a target offset based on the direction codes. It calls a routine with the offset and a mode number.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9DBE
name: choose_target_offset_by_direction
description: Picks one of three target offsets based on the direction codes, calls a routine with the chosen offset, then checks a state value and calls further routines when it is not six or four.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9DE2
name: choose_target_offset_by_direction
description: Picks a target offset based on the direction codes and calls a routine with it, then checks a state value and calls further routines when it is not six or four.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9E00
name: call_offset_then_check_state
description: Calls a routine with a mode of three and an offset of 400 plus a computed value, then checks a state value and calls further routines unless it is six or four. The last call is a cleanup step.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9E74
name: count_defeated_and_fleeing_foes
description: Counts the foes that have no health left and those in a fleeing state, then reports each non-zero count through a message routine when the battle state allows it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9E88
name: count_defeated_and_fleeing_foes
description: Counts the foes that have no health left and those in a fleeing state, then reports each non-zero count through a message routine when the battle state allows it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9EA0
name: tally_fleeing_foes_and_report
description: Counts the foes that are in a fleeing state and reports the total through a message routine when the battle state allows it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9ED0
name: report_battle_outcome_message
description: Reports the battle counts through message routines, choosing the messages from the battle state, and calls a further routine when the flag is set. The referenced text includes 'Bravely done!', one of the messages it can show.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9EEA
name: report_foes_fled_or_defeated
description: Reports how many foes fled or were defeated in battle using the referenced messages, and calls a further routine when the flag is non-zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:9F9C
name: check_actor_collision_at_index
description: Checks an actor against the other active actors and returns a code when a nearby one is found, skipping slots that are dead or in the excluded state. It returns zero when no conflict is found.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A00A
name: report_nearby_actor_code
description: Scans the other active actors for one within eleven units horizontally and nine vertically of this actor, and returns the code sixteen when one is found. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A010
name: scan_nearby_actors_from_index
description: Scans the other active actors from a starting index for one within eleven units horizontally and nine vertically, and returns sixteen when one is found. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A0B4
name: scan_nearby_actors_skip_first
description: Scans the other active actors, skipping its own slot and the slot at index one, for one within ten units horizontally and eight vertically, and returns sixteen when one is found. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A0C8
name: find_closest_actor_index
description: Scans the active actors from index one, skipping some dead or excluded entries, and tracks the one with the smallest value from a distance routine. It stores that actor's index and returns the smallest value found.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A0D8
name: find_closest_actor_to_record
description: Scans the active actors and compares each against a stored record, keeping the smallest value from a distance routine. The record's value is updated when a smaller one is found, and that smallest value is returned.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A13C
name: compute_approximate_distance
description: Works out the absolute horizontal and vertical gaps between two positions and returns a distance estimate from them. A further routine is called on the branch where one gap is within a factor of two of the other.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A1BA
name: call_pair_when_ratio_fits
description: When the first value is at most twice the second, calls two routines in turn. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A1C6
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in turn and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A1D8
name: try_move_actor_to_offset
description: Works out new coordinates for an actor from the given offsets, and stores them only when the collision check finds no conflict. It returns true when the actor was moved.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A266
name: store_actor_position
description: Stores two supplied coordinates into the actor record selected by the index, and returns one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A28A
name: draw_actor_image_pair
description: Draws one or two images for an entry in a four-byte table at the given position, using fixed sizes and offsets. A second image is drawn when the index is below nine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A362
name: run_palette_fade_steps
description: Chooses a constant from the current level and a mode value, clamps the intensity between zero and a limit, then loops over thirty-two colour entries calling routines to fetch and update each one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A568
name: randomize_palette_entries
description: Fills a 32-entry table with random values below 4096, loads it as a colour table and pauses one step, repeating for thirty-two rounds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A5C4
name: process_queued_message_event
description: Takes the next entry from a 32-entry event queue when one is waiting, then dispatches on its type code. Each case calls message and display routines with the stored coordinates, and an empty queue makes it call a wait routine with one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A5E2
name: dispatch_queued_event_by_type
description: Advances the event queue index and dispatches the entry it read by type, calling message and display routines for each case. It does not check whether the queue is empty.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A7EC
name: dispatch_event_from_argument
description: Dispatches on the event code passed in the data register, calling message and display routines for each case such as types two, three and four.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A86C
name: enqueue_event_code
description: Adds the event code to the 32-entry queue unless the queue is full, and advances the write index when it does.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A89A
name: draw_text_frame_and_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated text string, draws a fixed frame with two calls, then writes the text through a text routine with its measured length.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A8B2
name: draw_default_text_frame
description: Draws a fixed text frame and caption using three library calls, with fixed positions and sizes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A8F4
name: print_null_terminated_text
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and passes it, with its length, to a text routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A90C
name: invoke_library_vector_60
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, with no other work. The facts identify that routine as a library call at a fixed offset.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A91E
name: wrap_message_into_lines
description: Walks a message string, breaking lines at carriage returns and spaces, and expands percent escapes by inserting entries from a per-level table of names. Each line holds up to thirty-seven characters.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A93E
name: copy_message_chars_into_lines
description: Copies message characters into a line buffer, starting a new line at each carriage return and ending the buffer with a zero byte. It continues until a counter passes thirty-eight.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A978
name: copy_message_char_or_name
description: Copies one message character into the line buffer, or when the character is a percent escape it copies the current name from a per-level table of names. It advances the character count and continues the line.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A9AA
name: wrap_message_line_loop
description: Continues the line-wrapping loop by reading message characters up to the line limit, breaking at spaces and carriage returns, and ending the line at a zero byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A9AC
name: store_message_char_and_continue
description: Stores the current character in the line buffer, advances the count, and keeps the line-wrapping loop going until a break or the limit is reached.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:A9F2
name: finish_message_line
description: Ends the current line with a zero byte, and when the character count is still within the limit it hands the line to an output routine. It then resets the count and starts the next line.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AA1C
name: return_immediately_stub
description: Contains only a return, with no calls, memory access or register work. It is an empty entry in the message code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AA24
name: select_message_and_wrap
description: Skips forward through a list of zero-terminated strings to the one at the given index, then lays that text out into lines of up to thirty-seven characters.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AA2E
name: select_message_from_second_table
description: Skips forward through a second list of zero-terminated strings to the one at the given index, then lays that text out into lines of up to thirty-seven characters.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AA38
name: skip_strings_and_wrap_message
description: Advances past a given number of zero-terminated strings from the supplied pointer, then lays the text out into lines of up to thirty-seven characters.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AA52
name: print_item_message_with_suffix
description: Prints the message at the current table index, then the supplied text and a closing message. The referenced text includes the connecting phrases ' containing ' and ' found ', which this routine uses in its output.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AAA6
name: print_table_message_then_text
description: Prints the message at the current table index and then the supplied text, using the referenced connecting phrase ' found ' between them.
